decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The works to which this consent relates, must be begun not later than the expiration of three years beginning with the date of this consent.

Condition : 2 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted ( Drawing Numbers: 13003/05AA, 13003/05, 13003/05SET1, 13003/04AA, 13003/04, 13003/04SET1, 13003/02AA, 13003/02, 13003/02SET1, 13003/01AA, 13003/01, 13003/01SET1, Heritage Statement, Conservation Statement, Design and Access Statement, Location Plan, Market Assessment received 31/03/14. ) therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.
description: Internal alterations to the arrangement of kitchens and bathrooms and enclosure of bedrooms at mezzanine level.
